sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Bad Habit is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, come here a minute. I need to lay the wiring today, and plan for high power capacity, especially considering the continuous load on the grid. But that’s not the issue now, bring me some cigarettes. I want to work it hard until it’s done, and don't want to get distracted with searching. I know, smoking’s going to kill me. But is it really important though? Well, anyway, I need around 20 packs, preferably different ones. Oh, and make sure you get the new sealed ones, so look for them yourself. Was good seeing you."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 15 Malboro, Wilston or Strike cigarettes in raid
- Hand over the items

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Great, now I've got something to smoke in my free time. Thank you, mercenary."

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text: Unlocks craft for Wilston cigarettes at Nutrition Unit level 1.
